verdict.rationale: Qodo lets developers discuss or dismiss a finding [qodo-docs-3] and chat with the reviewer in the PR [qodo-docs-23]. It also documents a PR-history mechanism that learns from team activity [qodo-docs-48], and a Relevance score based on how the team handled similar findings before [qodo-docs-53]. That points to a feedback loop, but the docs never say a dismissed finding is suppressed in later reviews; Relevance scores likelihood rather than stopping repeats. Rule Miner [qodo-docs-13] mines rules from PR history but is not tied to rejected feedback. missing for 10: explicit documentation that dismissals or pushback suppress the same feedback in future reviews, per-developer or immediate learning from a single rejection, independent or hands-on corroboration that repeated rejected comments actually stop.
